title: Weekly Vessel Valuations Report, August 11 2026
summary:
Main
Bulkers
Values climbed this week. There was more evidence for strengthening buyer appetite formidage Japanese-built Ultramaxes, which resulted in values firming. Kamsarmax Royal Hope (81,000 DWT, 2015, JMU) sold by Tokei Kisen for USD 30.8 mil, VV Value USD 28.6 mil.
